info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Lease Management API
info.description: The Corporate Lease Management API facilitates the submission of corporate lease applications for financial services. This API allows businesses to initiate the lease application process, providing a streamlined way to manage leasing needs. Financial institutions and corporate clients can leverage this API to handle their lease transactions efficiently, improving operational workflow and customer satisfaction. Typical use cases include submitting lease agreements and tracking application status.

post.summary: Create a new corporate lease for deposit lending.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new corporate lease under the deposit lending scheme. It enables organizations to manage their lease agreements effectively and ensures that all required information is captured accurately for processing.
